system_description.narrative_title: Iran war morphs into energy/economic warfare centered on Hormuz
system_description.narrative_summary: Across this news window the dominant story is that the US–Iran war has shifted into an economic and energy-focused stalemate centered on the Strait of Hormuz. Diplomacy with Oman over reopening Hormuz, Iranian threats to shipping and naval assertions, US sanctions and blockades, and China/Gulf-state maneuvering are interacting to reshape oil flows, shipping risk, and financial sanctions dynamics. The result is a feedback-rich open system driving higher costs, shifting alliances, and market volatility.
system_description.scope: Actors and processes affecting Strait of Hormuz access and consequences: Iran, Oman, the U.S., China, Gulf states, navies and tankers, oil producers/traders, sanctions authorities, banks and insurers, shipping traffic, and oil/financial markets during negotiations and economic warfare in late Aug 2026.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-energy-financial system (international security, energy supply chains, and cross-border finance)
adjacent_subsystems: Global oil markets and energy security
Regional security architecture in the Middle East
Global maritime trade and shipping chokepoints

variables.name: Strait interference risk
variables.description: The probability and expected frequency of physical or operational interference with commercial transit through the strait (harassment, attacks, interdictions, or closure).

variables.name: Naval force presence
variables.description: The density and readiness level of armed maritime assets operating in and around the strait region.

variables.name: Commercial vessel transit rate
variables.description: The number of commercial ships passing through the strait per unit time.

variables.name: Oil export rate through strait
variables.description: The volume of crude oil and oil products transported via the strait per unit time.

variables.name: Alternative export capacity
variables.description: Installed throughput capacity of pipelines, terminals, and routes that bypass the strait (barrels per day).

variables.name: Tanker positioning count
variables.description: The number of tankers loitering, staged, or piled up in nearby waters awaiting orders or safe passage.

variables.name: Shipping insurance premium level
variables.description: Average war-risk and route-specific insurance premiums charged for voyages through or near the strait.

variables.name: Insurance coverage availability
variables.description: The proportion of cargoes and voyages that can obtain comprehensive war-risk insurance for transit in the region.

variables.name: Shipping operational cost index
variables.description: Composite per-voyage cost including fuel, detour distance, insurance surcharges, and security-related fees for regional shipping.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: The market price level of benchmark crude (reflecting global supply–demand and risk premia).

variables.name: Financial sanctions pressure
variables.description: The intensity, scope, and enforcement vigor of financial restrictions applied against targeted economic actors.

variables.name: Banking correspondent access
variables.description: The degree to which affected actors can access international correspondent banking, payment channels, and trade finance.

variables.name: Commodity market volatility
variables.description: The realized short-term volatility in energy and related commodity markets driven by risk perceptions and shocks.

variables.name: Diplomatic negotiation intensity
variables.description: The rate and concentration of diplomatic engagements and negotiation actions aimed at resolving access and sanctions disputes.

variables.name: Coalition coordination strength
variables.description: The degree of policy alignment and coordinated action among external actors on naval operations, sanctions, and market interventions.

variables.name: Domestic social and political stability
variables.description: The level of internal social cohesion, protest activity, and political resilience within the economy under economic pressure.

catalysts.title: Iran–Oman Hormuz accord negotiations
catalysts.description: Ongoing talks between Iran and Oman to agree terms for Strait of Hormuz reopening and revenue sharing, with intermittent US influence. Outcomes will affect safe‑passage arrangements and traffic levels.
catalysts.rationale: Iran and Oman edge towards deal; Reuters: 'Iran and Oman edge towards deal on Strait of Hormuz' and 'Iran and Oman still working on Strait of Hormuz accord'.

catalysts.title: Iran threats to crack down on transiting ships
catalysts.description: Iranian warnings and policy statements threatening to target or detain transiting vessels create a sustained pressure campaign that raises interception risk and market fear.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran threatens 46 ships in Strait of Hormuz transit crackdown' and 'Iran's navy says it has "full control" over Strait of Hormuz'.

catalysts.title: Additional tanker attack in/near Hormuz
catalysts.description: A new strike on a tanker or convoy in the Hormuz approaches, likely provoking immediate shipping disruptions, repositioning and insurance reactions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'New Tanker Strike in Hormuz as Iran Vows Retaliation' and repeated reports of tanker attacks.

catalysts.title: Iranian tankers staging off Sri Lanka
catalysts.description: Iranian tankers gathering off Sri Lanka signal rerouting and staging away from Hormuz, affecting tanker queues and flows through the strait.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Iranian tankers gather off Sri Lankan coast' indicating tanker repositioning to avoid Hormuz disruption.

catalysts.title: Expansion of US banking sanctions related to Iran
catalysts.description: Continued Treasury actions targeting banks dealing with Iran (Egyptian/UAE branches) will further choke finance channels for trade and exports.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'US hits Egyptian bank branches with Iran sanctions' and 'Treasury moves to sanction UAE branch of Egyptian bank over Iran ties'.

catalysts.title: Saudi push for state-backed war insurance
catalysts.description: Talks in Riyadh on state-backed war insurance for shipping could broaden coverage or lower premiums if implemented, altering shipping economics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Saudi Arabia holds talks over state-backed war insurance as costs jump' signals potential policy launch.

catalysts.title: Aramco shifts cargoes outside Hormuz to China
catalysts.description: Saudi shipments diverted outside Hormuz toward Asian buyers reduce Strait throughput and demonstrate market reallocation of supply.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Aramco offers more oil outside Hormuz with some cargoes heading to China'.

catalysts.title: G20 finance meeting on sanctions and Iran
catalysts.description: US‑hosted G20 finance discussions could coordinate sanctions or relief steps, shifting multilateral pressure and finance access for Iran.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US-hosted G20 finance meeting to target growth, imbalances, Iran sanctions, Treasury official says'.

catalysts.title: Qatar diplomatic de‑escalation shuttle to Iran
catalysts.description: Qatar's mission to Tehran aims to reduce tensions and could catalyze confidence measures affecting transit risk and talks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Qatari PM heads to Iran to "de‑escalate tensions"' and related diplomatic coverage.
